game.title: Pokémon LeafGreen
game.revision_note: LeafGreen v1.0 and v1.1 use different master codes and different addresses for most cheats — codes are NOT interchangeable between revisions, and LeafGreen codes are not identical to FireRed's.

codes.name: CodeBreaker Enable Code (v1.0)
codes.description: Must-be-on enabler for CodeBreaker codes on v1.0 (item, money and modifier codes need it). Add as its own cheat and enable it.

codes.name: Master Code (v1.0)
codes.description: Must-be-on master code for GameShark v3 / Action Replay codes on v1.0. Add as its own cheat and enable it.

codes.name: Master Code + Anti-DMA (v1.1)
codes.description: Required pairing for ALL v1.1 cheats: master code (first two lines) plus Anti-DMA (last two lines). Enter as one cheat, or as two cheats both enabled.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls (v1.0)
codes.description: Walk through walls, trees and buildings. Enter both lines as one cheat.
side_effects: Stacking multiple active cheats can cause crashes, freezes and save corruption — disable after use.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls (v1.1)
codes.description: Walk through walls for v1.1 ROMs — different addresses than the v1.0 code; do not mix revisions.

codes.name: Rare Candy in PC (v1.0)
codes.description: Fills the PC item slot with Rare Candies. Withdraw at a Pokémon Center PC.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw
side_effects: Quantity may display as 0 in the PC — withdraw anyway.
Overwrites the first PC item slot — move anything stored there first.
Uses the same slot address as the Master Ball code — enable only one at a time.

codes.name: Master Ball in PC (v1.0)
codes.description: Fills the PC item slot with Master Balls. Withdraw at a Pokémon Center PC.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw
side_effects: Quantity may display as 0 in the PC — withdraw anyway.
Uses the same slot address as the Rare Candy code — enable only one at a time.

codes.name: Max Money (v1.0)
codes.description: Press B + Start in-game to max out your money.
side_effects: FireRed/LeafGreen are unstable with many codes — enable one at a time, save, then disable.

codes.name: Shiny Wild Pokémon (v1.0)
codes.description: All wild encounters are shiny. Enter all four lines as one cheat.
side_effects: May lock the Pokémon's nature and gender (all-female encounters reported).
Do NOT breed Pokémon caught with this cheat — bad-egg risk.
Turn the cheat off before saving.

codes.name: Shiny Wild Pokémon (v1.1)
codes.description: Shiny wild encounters for v1.1 ROMs, re-tested by the source site.
side_effects: Same caveats as the v1.0 shiny code: possible nature/gender lock; do not breed cheat-caught Pokémon.

codes.name: No Random Battles (v1.0)
codes.description: Disables random wild encounters. Explicitly does NOT work on v1.1.
side_effects: Reported not to work on v1.1, with mixed reports on some emulators.
